<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—multiple peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart with decreasing intensities following a binomial distribution—the pattern is characteristic of the natural 13C/12C isotopic distribution. No other distinct isotopic patterns (e.g., Cl, Br, S) are evident. Therefore, carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
